channel.title: The Nevada Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Nevada Independent (thenevadaindependent.com)

item.title: $63 million in refunds headed to overcharged NV Energy customers
item.description: On Tuesday, state energy regulators unanimously voted to accept a nearly $63 million settlement offer proposed by NV Energy after the utility inadvertently overcharged 43,000 customers over the last two decades.

item.title: DMV de Nevada admite haber hablado con ICE a través de una aplicación encriptada
item.description: El DMV de Nevada dijo que las conversaciones no se relacionaron con aplicación de leyes migratorias.

item.title: OPINION: It’s called the Bureau of Land Management, not the Bureau of Land Disposal
item.description: Once these lands are altered, they can never be restored to their original state. Not only could we lose iconic landscapes forever, but selling off public lands is detrimental to the health and well-being of our communities.

item.title: Does Las Vegas have Flock license plate reader cameras?
item.description: Find out in our latest fact brief.

item.title: Confusion over Nevada health insurance program’s finances clouds future for state workers
item.description: In recent weeks, questions arose about how much money is actually in the program’s coffers, stopping discussion on possible changes.

item.title: ‘Everybody jumped in.’ Legendary bookmaker says sports betting grew too fast
item.description: Book by Art Manteris covers his 50 years in legal sports betting, praises Nevada and worries about rapid growth. Also, will stadium’s landlord lend help?

item.title: La policía de Las Vegas usa lectores de placas; el público tiene poca voz en esa implementación
item.description: El Departamento de la Policía Metropolitana de Las Vegas hizo silenciosamente un acuerdo con Flock Security, una empresa de lectores automáticos de placas que usa cámaras para recopilar información del vehículo y verificarla con bases de datos policiales.

item.title: Nevada officials want to keep childhood vaccine rules intact after feds relax them
item.description: Several health agencies have asked a state board to formally reject the Trump administration’s guidance, which made more shots optional for schoolchildren.

item.title: Clientes de NV Energy que pagaron de más recibirán $63 millones en reembolsos
item.description: Reguladores estatales aceptaron este martes una oferta de acuerdo de casi $63 millones por parte de NV Energy después de que esa empresa de servicios públicos cobró de más y de manera accidental a 108,000 clientes durante las recientes dos décadas.

item.title: Judge rules Lombardo’s trans athlete ballot initiative can proceed — but with new description
item.description: A description of the proposal’s effects must say it would carve out an exception to the state Constitution’s guarantee of equal rights regardless of gender identity.
